title: A new construction of the Riemannian deformation sequence
summary: We obtain a new construction of a sequence of invariant differential operators on a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ that governs the linearized deformation theory of $g$. Starting from an explicit linear connection on a natural bundle $\mathcal AM\to M$, we construct a twisted de Rham sequence and then apply an analog of the construction of BGG sequences. If $g$ has constant sectional curvature, both sequences are complexes which compute the cohomology of the sheaf of local Killing fields, which are equivalent to parallel sections of $\mathcal AM$.
